summary: YYForce Inc., a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, reported via Form 6-K the completed acquisition of Xtreme Solution Pte. Ltd. from Madam Ren Yinan under a sales and purchase agreement dated August 3, 2026. The filing furnishes audited target financials for FY ended March 31, 2026 and 2025 plus unaudited pro forma combined information through June 30, 2026, because the target is a significant business under Regulation S-X Rule 3-05. No purchase price, premium, consideration mix, advisor, or closing conditions were disclosed; the 6-K is incorporated by reference into existing F-3 and S-8 registrations. Watch for deal economics and integration risk in later filings.
